description: This file provides helper classes and interfaces for testing buffer serialization types within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes methods to generate test serializers, abstract classes for buffer testing, and specific implementations for different buffer writer types.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper`1
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to create test serializers and internal classes for buffer testing.

classes.name: IBufferTestSerializer
classes.description: Interface defining serialization and deserialization methods for buffer test serializers.

classes.name: BufferTester`1
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing IBufferTestSerializer for specific buffer writer types, managing serialization sessions.

classes.name: MultiSegmentBufferWriterTester
classes.description: Concrete implementation of BufferTester for TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter, with configurable options.

classes.name: StructBufferWriterTester
classes.description: Concrete implementation of BufferTester for TestBufferWriterStruct.

classes.name: PooledOutputBuffer
classes.description: Struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> and IOutputBuffer, wrapping a PooledBuffer for pooled buffer writing.

classes.name: PooledBufferWriterTester
classes.description: Concrete implementation of BufferTester for PooledOutputBuffer.

methods.name: GetTestSerializers
methods.description: Creates an array of test serializers for different buffer writer types based on provided max sizes.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a TValue input into an output buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a ReadOnlySequence<byte> into a TValue output.

methods.name: CreateBufferWriter
methods.description: Abstract method to create a specific buffer writer instance.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the buffer tester instance.
